citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015, USGS Open-File Report 2016-1192
evidence_used: Event-specific tectonic summaries for M7+ Sumatra-Java megathrust, intraslab, and Wharton Basin oceanic-intraplate earthquakes from 2000 through 2015 (including 2004 M9.1, 2005 M8.6 Nias, 2007 M8.4 Bengkulu, 2010 M7.8 Mentawai, and 2012 M8.6/M8.2 Wharton Basin).
limitations_and_caveats: Scope limited to M7+ through 2015; excludes M6.5-6.9 events and post-2015 M7+ events.

citation: Hasterok et al. (2022), New Maps of Global Geological Provinces and Tectonic Plates, Earth-Science Reviews 231, 104069
evidence_used: Subplate overlays across West Sumatra (39), Sunda (29), Capricorn (7), and Indian (2).
limitations_and_caveats: Hasterok Sunda polygon wraps northeast into Celebes Sea / Moro Gulf, mis-tagging 13 deep Celebes/Mindanao slab events (523-641 km) as SUNDA_JAVA, and splits the 2012 Wharton Basin M8.6/M8.2 doublet across Capricorn and Indian subplates.

citation: Bird (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027
evidence_used: Plate boundary reference separating Sunda, Australia, India, and Burma plates along the Sumatra-Java Trench.
limitations_and_caveats: Surface boundary discretization only; does not represent 3D slab depth contours.

citation: Hayes et al. (2018), Slab2, a comprehensive subduction zone geometry model, Science 362(6410), 58-61
evidence_used: 3D slab geometry reference separating Sumatra-Java slab dip (to ~530 km under Flores Sea) from the distinct Celebes/Molucca slab system beneath Moro Gulf.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional 3D slab context; individual event mechanisms require ComCat detail product verification.
